name: Duplicate counter
description: Count how often each repeated item occurs (list.count called for every element).
fixture_description: items: n_items lowercase words drawn from a vocabulary of about unique_ratio*n_items words with Zipf-like frequencies (exponent skew).

expected_output.description: Mapping of every item that occurs more than once to its occurrence count (dict equality, key order ignored).

suspected_bottleneck: `items.count(item)` rescans the whole list for every element: O(n^2).
